CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetClientVariablesList

Returns a comma-delimited list of the names of the client variables stored for this visitor in the current application. The read-only variables CFID, CFToken, URLToken, HitCount, TimeCreated and LastVisit are left out.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetClientVariablesList()

Returns

An upper-case list of variable names, or an empty string if there are none or client management is off.

Usage

Client management must be turned on with CFAPPLICATION CLIENTMANAGEMENT="Yes". Client variables can be stored in the registry (the default), in a data source or in a cookie (CLIENTSTORAGE="Cookie"); the storage location is chosen on the Variables page of the Administrator or in CFAPPLICATION.

Client variables hold simple values only: strings, numbers, dates and Booleans. Use DeleteClientVariable to remove one.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFAPPLICATION NAME="SnippetClientDemo" CLIENTMANAGEMENT="Yes" CLIENTSTORAGE="Cookie">
<CFSET Client.Browser = "Netscape 4.7">
<CFSET Client.Modem = "56K">
<CFSET Client.Visits = Client.HitCount>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Your client ID is #Client.CFID#.
<P>Variables you may change: <B>#GetClientVariablesList()#</B>
<UL>
<CFLOOP LIST="#GetClientVariablesList()#" INDEX="v">
  <LI>Client.#v# = #Evaluate("Client." & v)#
</CFLOOP>
</UL>
</CFOUTPUT>
